title: Web app crashes with "indirect call to null" on startup when AudioStreamPlayer (with playlist) Autoplay is enabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Windows 11 Version 24H2 (OS Build 26100.4946) - v4.4.1.stable.official - OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0) - Compatibility - Using Device: Mozilla - ANGLE (AMD, Radeon R9 200 Series Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0), or similar - dedicated AMD RX 5700XT

### Issue description

When exporting a Godot 4.4.1 project to HTML5, the web app crashes on startup if an AudioStreamPlayer with a playlist has Autoplay enabled. The same project runs fine on desktop (the editor and native exports work without errors), but the exported HTML5 build does not launch in the browser.
- On Mozilla Firefox 142.0 (64-bit):
```
RuntimeError: indirect call to null
    _main http://localhost:8051/index.js:9
    callMain http://localhost:8051/index.js:9
    Engine http://localhost:8051/index.js:801
    Engine http://localhost:8051/index.js:796
    promise callback*start http://localhost:8051/index.js:775
    Engine http://localhost:8051/index.js:834
    promise callback*startGame http://localhost:8051/index.js:833
    <anonymous> http://localhost:8051/:202
    <anonymous> http://localhost:8051/:216
[localhost:8051:153:11](http://localhost:8051/)
    displayFailureNotice http://localhost:8051/:153
    (Async: promise callback)
    <anonymous> http://localhost:8051/:212
    <anonymous> http://localhost:8051/:216
```
- On Google chrome Version 139.0.7258.139 (Official Build) (64-bit):
```
index.js:459 Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
index.js:459 OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)) - Compatibility - Using Device: WebKit - WebKit WebGL
(index):153 RuntimeError: null function or function signature mismatch
    at 0c6d89be:0x3b95ab
    at 0c6d89be:0x72f836
    at 0c6d89be:0x299f281
    at 0c6d89be:0x4efd3
    at 0c6d89be:0x13346a8
    at 0c6d89be:0x1334aad
    at 0c6d89be:0x1334aad
    at 0c6d89be:0x61ff9c
    at 0c6d89be:0x2c16daf
    at 0c6d89be:0x106499d
displayFailureNotice @ (index):153
Promise.then
(anonymous) @ (index):212
(anonymous) @ (index):216
```

### Steps to reproduce

Ensure that the Autoplay option is enabled on the ```AudioStreamPlayerBugged``` node and that it has an AudioStreamPlaylist assigned to its Stream property.
Export using the default "Web" preset and run the build locally (for example: ```python -m http.server 8050```) or use the built-in "Run in Browser" option.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[audioplaylistwebglbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21939264/audioplaylistwebglbug.zip)
